application: Already-running installed desktop app; same PID throughout test

source.type: Temporary loopback MacCMS catalogue with real remote HTTPS media
source.entries: Two separately identified entries for the same public movie, used to test queue advancement
source.nonCloudEvidence: Reviewed built-in MacCMS direct resolver; public Blender media origin; no cloud-drive save/account workflow
productionProviderLimitations: Configured built-in Libvio and its supported alternate origin returned HTTP 403 before playback
Configured children source returned a no-data placeholder

controls: Production Swing UI buttons/slider invoked in the existing process; mpv IPC queried for observed state. No simulated playback/end callbacks. Temporary Java attach probes did not transform application classes.

embeddedPlayback.visualCheck: Movie rendered in fullscreen on the running display

automaticNext.method: Seek near end and resume; actual natural completion, no synthetic end event

manualExternalHandoff.issue: Position restoration jumped near the end of the remote MKV. A subsequent diagnostic exact seek also reached EOF. Root cause is not isolated; do not attribute this solely to the handoff implementation yet.

automaticExternalFallback.fault: Temporary invalid native parent-window ID, restored immediately afterward

limitations: The two-entry catalogue is a controlled test fixture, not a verified episodic third-party service
Audible sound and hardware-decoder use were not independently measured
Manual handoff position retention failed on this long network MKV; short local-media tests had passed
